compiled_state.description:
# Land PR #127 via Gerrit: pypandoc-binary 1.17 + ruff 0.16.2; mcp 2.0 deferred to 732b

## Context / Problem

GitHub is a read-only mirror: dependabot PRs never merge there; content is re-applied
locally and landed via Gerrit, then the PR is closed by hand. PR #127 proposes:
`pypandoc-binary` `1.15` -> `1.17` (pinned EXACTLY, `wiki` extra + `dev` group);
`ruff` `0.16.1` -> `0.16.2` (pinned EXACTLY in `dev` — hook, local lint, CI identical);
and `mcp` `1.29.0` -> `2.0.0` (major), loosening the pyproject ceiling `<2` -> `<3`.

The `mcp` half is the third re-proposal (PRs #124/#125/#127), rejected under ticket 1dfd
(mcp 2.0 removes `mcp.server.fastmcp`, imported by mcp_server.py + gen_mcp_reference.py);
migration is epic `732b-51df-acf2-477b`: stay on `mcp>=1.28.1,<2` until 2.0.x stabilizes.
This ticket lands the safe subset only.

## Approach

Land the `pypandoc-binary` + `ruff` bumps; the `mcp` ceiling stays `<2`. In a fresh
worktree branched from `origin/main`:

1. `pyproject.toml`: `pypandoc-binary==1.15` -> `==1.17` in BOTH `wiki` and `dev`;
   `ruff==0.16.1` -> `==0.16.2` in `dev`. Keep both pins exact.
2. `uv lock --upgrade-package pypandoc-binary --upgrade-package ruff` — the lock is
   regenerated by uv, never hand-edited (CI gates on `uv lock --check`); sync the venv.
3. **Pin-provenance consumers**: read the new BUNDLED pandoc version empirically
   (`pypandoc.get_pandoc_version()`), then update EVERY hard-coded pin site (inventory:
   `grep -rn '3\.6\.1|1\.15'` over the whole tree, excluding only uv.lock and captured
   fixture data):
   * `NOTICE` — the `Version:` line + the `pypandoc-binary==1.15` wheel reference; and
     the `"3.6.1" in text` assertion in `tests/unit/test_notice_records_pandoc_gpl.py`.
     Do NOT touch its upstream-URL assertion (`"pandoc.org" in text or ...`) — a
     parallel change owns that exact line.
   * `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_wiki_render.py` — NON-skipping provenance asserts
     `pypandoc.__version__ == "1.15"` (L55) + banner `pandoc 3.6.1` (L59), and ADR
     asserts `"3.6.1" in adr` / `"1.15" in adr` (L326-327).
   * ADR 0095 — the "Pin provenance" pin + bundled-pandoc line (what L326-327 read).
   * ADR 0096 — the Finding recording the pins + both fingerprints (lockstep with 4b).
   * `wiki_render.py` module docstring's `pandoc 3.6.1` mention (accuracy only).
   * `tests/scripts/test_generate_dc_wiki_legacy_outputs.py` — passes hard-coded "3.6.1"
     to `validate_pandoc_provenance` against provenance built from
     `generator.LEGACY_PANDOC_VERSION` (L103/111/193/201/203/247); after 4a the
     version-match check raises — update the literals (or derive from the constant).
   `tests/fixtures/dc_wiki_corpus/code_arrow.json` mentions the old pins too but is
   captured ticket data — leave byte-identical.
4. **Byte-safety corpus**: `scripts/generate_dc_wiki_legacy_outputs.py` freezes
   `LEGACY_PANDOC_VERSION = "3.6.1"` + a per-platform `SUPPORTED_PANDOC_BINARY_SHA256`
   map (darwin-arm64, linux-x86_64); test_wiki_render_hardening.py's provenance test
   validates the installed binary's version + SHA-256 against the provenance in
   `tests/fixtures/dc_wiki_legacy_outputs.json` + the three replay files. Bumping the
   wheel = deliberately re-establishing the reviewed baseline (sanctioned by the
   generator's docstring):
   a. Update `LEGACY_PANDOC_VERSION` to the new bundled version.
   b. Recompute BOTH fingerprints: darwin-arm64 = SHA-256 of the locally installed
      pandoc; linux-x86_64 = download the exact 1.17 manylinux x86_64 wheel recorded
      (URL + hash) in `uv.lock`, extract, hash the `pandoc` inside — no Linux host
      needed; wheel integrity is attested by uv.lock.
   c. Regenerate the legacy manifest + three replay files with the generator (supported
      binaries of one version emit byte-identical fixtures, so a darwin regeneration is
      valid for CI's linux gate; the provenance test enforces this).
   d. Confirm with the script's non-writing `--check` + test_wiki_render_hardening.py.
   If the bytes churn implausibly (unit count deviates from 884, or `--check` disagrees),
   STOP: defer the pypandoc half too (land ruff alone) rather than commit an unreviewed
   baseline. STOP fallback done-state: pypandoc half moves to a
   discovered_from follow-up ticket; this ticket completes on the ruff-only subset
   (AC1/AC3/AC4 re-scoped to the follow-up; AC2 = ruff only; AC5-AC7 unchanged).
   (Not exercised: the bump landed cleanly.)
5. **ruff verdict drift**: run `make lint`; if 0.16.2 flags or reformats existing code,
   apply the minimal fix and note it in the commit message. NEVER touch
   `.github/complexity-baseline.json`.
6. Do NOT touch `mcp` constraints, `_optionality.yml`, ADR 0050 — 732b's edit-set.
7. Verify (`make lint`, `make typecheck`, `pytest tests/unit tests/scripts`, generator
   `--check`), commit with a `rebar-ticket:` trailer + DCO sign-off, push
   `git push gerrit HEAD:refs/for/main`; leave the ticket `in_progress` while the bots
   vote; close only after merge, with PR #127 closed by a comment pointing at 732b.

## Scope

* `pyproject.toml` — the two `pypandoc-binary==` pins (`wiki` + `dev`) + the `dev`
  `ruff==` pin.
* `uv.lock` — regenerated entries + incidental churn.
* Pin-provenance consumers (step 3): `NOTICE`, notice test (version string only, never
  the upstream-URL line), test_wiki_render.py pin asserts, ADR 0095 "Pin provenance" +
  ADR 0096 pin/fingerprint findings, `wiki_render.py` docstring,
  `tests/scripts/test_generate_dc_wiki_legacy_outputs.py` version literals.
* `scripts/generate_dc_wiki_legacy_outputs.py` — `LEGACY_PANDOC_VERSION` + both
  `SUPPORTED_PANDOC_BINARY_SHA256` entries, nothing else.
* `tests/fixtures/dc_wiki_legacy_outputs.json` + three `tests/fixtures/dc_wiki_replay/`
  files — regenerated wholesale by the generator, never hand-edited.
* Minimal source fixes ONLY if ruff 0.16.2 changes a lint/format verdict.
* OUT: the `mcp` bump and its `<2` -> `<3` ceiling move (deferred to epic
  `732b-51df-acf2-477b` — already filed, no new ticket needed);
  `.github/workflows/_optionality.yml`; ADR 0050; `.github/complexity-baseline.json`;
  dependabot config; other open dependency PRs.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] AC1: `pyproject.toml` has `pypandoc-binary==1.17` (twice), `ruff==0.16.2`, and
  still `mcp>=1.28.1,<2` in both places
  (`grep -nE 'pypandoc-binary==|ruff==|mcp>=' pyproject.toml`).
- [x] AC2: `uv.lock` records pypandoc-binary 1.17, ruff 0.16.2, mcp 1.29.0
  (`grep -A1 -E '^name = "(pypandoc-binary|ruff|mcp)"$' uv.lock`); `uv lock --check`
  exits 0 (CI's gate).
- [x] AC3: every pin-provenance consumer names the versions 1.17 actually ships (per
  `pypandoc.get_pandoc_version()`): `NOTICE`, the notice test's version string,
  test_wiki_render.py's provenance asserts, ADR 0095 Pin provenance, ADR 0096
  fingerprints; `pytest tests/unit/test_notice_records_pandoc_gpl.py
  tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_wiki_render.py` exits 0 (non-skipping).
- [x] AC4: baseline re-established: `LEGACY_PANDOC_VERSION` + both fingerprints match
  the 1.17 wheels (darwin from the installed binary, linux from the uv.lock-pinned
  manylinux x86_64 wheel), fixtures regenerated by the script (never hand-edited),
  `python scripts/generate_dc_wiki_legacy_outputs.py --check` exits 0, and
  `pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_wiki_render_hardening.py` exits 0.
- [x] AC5: `make lint` (ruff 0.16.2), `make typecheck`, `pytest tests/unit`, and
  `pytest tests/scripts/test_generate_dc_wiki_legacy_outputs.py` all exit 0 with the
  worktree `.venv/bin` first on PATH.
- [x] AC6: a Gerrit change carrying this diff exists on refs/for/main with this
  ticket's `rebar-ticket:` trailer and DCO sign-off (`git log -1 --format=%B HEAD`).
- [x] AC7: mcp 2.0 NOT landed (no edit to the `mcp` constraints, `_optionality.yml`, or
  ADR 0050 per `git diff origin/main --stat`); deferral recorded as a ticket comment
  naming epic `732b-51df-acf2-477b`.
